answer: The yarrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime.
